status_note: 3d-model-pipeline stage 7a (pilot 2026-10-14): UE import of the Achilles look-dev run 20261014-h2-lookdev-r2 (profile achilles-h2-lookdev/3: generic h2_bake H2 figure of the bake run 20261014-h2-bake-r2 + UV1 in metres, MatID, Edge, graded BC/ORM; TeamAccent of profile achilles-h2-lookdev-teamaccent/3 = sword-belt/pteruges leather 1.47 % + kilt hem 0.61 % = 2.23 % of the figure, below the 5-12 % range under P3-4/P3-4b) through the CLI profile skeletal-adopt (normaliser h2-lookdev/1) onto the canonical skeleton /Game/PipelineCandidates/Achilles/Rig/SK_Achilles_Skeleton. Spear in the RIGHT hand (weapon.R, UE weapon side +Y as King Arthur and Angel); the round shield on the left forearm is part of the body mesh (rigid on arm_lower.L, no bone). MI of /Game/UM/Materials/v2/M_UM_Figure_v2 (UseTeamAccent, UseUV1Metres) with the TeamAccent mask and the look-dev LUT as is (UE look-dev iteration 0); base on M_UM_BaseMarker. Teams = the active C-11 palette P1 #E8C06A / P2 #5A7F9F (user decision 'accents + ring'). At most 'technically imported'; art acceptance of the model by delegation (stage 4 r2 pass 8.8, evidence/acceptance/20261014-r2/card.json). Rev 2 (UE look-dev r2, 2026-10-14, light mode by delegation): only the hero LUT changes (20261014-h2ld-ldc-ue/lut/T_UM_MatLUT_Achilles_UE_r2, overrides note_ue_r2): bronze F0 linear [0.343, 0.125, 0.033] (sRGB hue 27, sat 0.68; was the pale [0.9216, 0.5776, 0.2582]), worn edge [0.604, 0.296, 0.107], roughness 0.28; wool_coarse sheen 0.08 / specular 0.25; linen sheen 0.06 / specular 0.25; leather_smooth specular 0.2 / roughness 0.58; leather_worn specular 0.25 / roughness 0.55. Review r1 had bronze 4.6x and pale (hue +8.3, sat -0.36), the red cloth 2.4-2.7x and pink, the leather 1.9x relative to the skin. Re-import by references/ue-import-package.md §4.4 (assets of 20261014-h2ld-ue-import deleted by script) into run 20261014-h2ld-ue-import-r2.
